<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is a `.SRCINFO` metadata file for the `sonic-oxygen` AUR package. It contains standard package description information: `pkgbase`, `pkgver`, `url`, `license`, `depends`, `makedepends`, and `source` with a verified `sha256sums` checksum. The source URL points to the official GitHub repository at a specific tagged release (`6.8.0`), and the checksum is provided (not `SKIP`), which is proper practice. There are no suspicious network requests, obfuscated commands (no `eval`, `base64`, `curl|bash`, etc.), unexpected file operations, or dangerous patterns. All dependencies are standard system/library packages expected for a Qt-based desktop theme/decoration package. The content is entirely consistent with legitimate AUR packaging conventions.

The package appears to be a genuine SonicDE Oxygen style port, with all metadata matching the upstream project at `https://github.com/Sonic-DE/sonic-oxygen`. No evidence of injected malicious code, data exfiltration, backdoors, or supply-chain attack indicators was found.
</details>

- The `source=` line uses `$pkgname‑$pkgver.tar.gz` while `$pkgname` is an array; this may cause build failures but is not a security threat.
- All source URLs resolve to the declared upstream GitHub repository (`https://github.com/Sonic‑DE/sonic‑oxygen`).
- No `eval`, `base64`, or unexpected network downloads are present; only standard `cmake` build and install steps are performed.
</details>
